fusions.name: Bristle Moult
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sheds a ring of bristles that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand-Bound Blow
fusions.desc: A strike with your weapon wound in shed strands that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Regrown Coat
fusions.desc: Regrows a coat of strands that absorbs the next 20 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 5%.

fusions.name: Bristling Hide
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
